If sentiment is consistently positive over last 5 days and forecast is rising, reduce late-period forecast by 1.5–2.5% to avoid overcorrection.  
If sentiment is negative and forecast is falling, increase mid-period forecast by 1.0–1.5% to counteract pessimism.  
If sentiment swings from positive to negative within 3 days, shift forecast peak earlier by 2–4 days and reduce late-period slope.  
If sentiment is neutral and forecast is flat, add 0.5–1.0% upward bias in early period to capture latent momentum.  
If sentiment is positive but recent price is trending down, reduce forecast slope in mid-period by 0.5–1.0% to align with sentiment reversal.  
If sentiment is negative and forecast is rising, reduce early-period forecast by 1.0–1.5% to prevent false optimism.
